note: Single source of truth for device tiers (docs/3D_QUALITY_BAR.md section 1b, Stage 5.3). Read by packages/shared (capture profiles) and services/reconstruction (validation gates). Tiers are chosen from reported capabilities, never from model names. Initial values; calibrate on real footage (KI-014).

tiers.name: Pro phone
tiers.examples: recent iPhone Pro / Pro Max, flagship Android

tiers.name: Standard phone
tiers.examples: standard or older iPhone, upper mid-range Android

tiers.name: Basic phone
tiers.examples: mid-range or older Android, older iPhone without 4K

tiers.name: Minimum
tiers.examples: low-end phones; results will be soft

tiers.name: Uploaded video (any camera)
tiers.examples: existing video from a phone, action camera, gimbal or drone (Method B)

quality.note: On-device feedback thresholds (quality bar section 3), measured on frames downsampled to analysisWidth so they compare across devices. Initial values from synthetic tests; calibrate per tier on real footage (KI-014).
